subject: Mathematics

source.subtopic: Number 2: numeral, number word 'two' and pegboard pattern

show.line: This is two. Two eyes to see. Two ears to hear. Two!

rounds.prompt: How many ears do you have for hearing? Tap the number.
How many noses do you have for smelling?
Things we have one of go here. Things we have two of go there.
Draw two with your finger. Go round at the top, then along the bottom.

hints: Two is one and one more. Like your two eyes.
Touch your ears. One, two. That is two.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count the ears.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: One ear! There is only one ear.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! There are two ears for hearing.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count them together. One, two ears!

parent_line: Can recognise, say and trace the number 2.
